EntryID: Primary key for this table, the key of each record
SubmissionID: ID of the submission (the received data containing all the spending categories)
CustomerID: The ID for the user that submitted this data
Month: The month that this transaction is for. format: (YYYY-MM)
Category: The category name for the spend (Travel/Food/Utilities)
Amount: How much the customer spent on this subcategory
DateSubmitted: The date and time of the submission
